en: A black and white photograph postcard displaying a steam-powered cargo ship at anchor in a harbor. In the background, across the water, are old European-style buildings, with a distinctive castle-like structure featuring a round tower. The setting appears to be a northern European port city, likely in the early 20th century based on the ship's design and the overall photographic style. The image contains no visible text.
